segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I have you at 42 support seats today, contract runs through May 31, and you mentioned adding the field service group before the June 17 go-live. Is that still 18 more users?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Close, it's 16 now. Two contractors rolled off. So 58 total seats, and we need access live by June 10 for training, not the 17th.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 58 total and training on June 10. On term, we can align the added seats to your current renewal and then move everything onto a fresh 12-month term starting June 1. That keeps one invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: One invoice is important. Last year accounting asked why there were two lines, so if it's one annual invoice, payable net 30, that's clean.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep. Based on the pricing sheet, 58 seats at the annual rate is $43,152 for the year. With the implementation package you already bought, there's no new setup fee. Taxes would show separately on the invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Procurement will ask about the auto-renew language. We can accept 12 months, but we need 30 days' written notice to cancel before renewal.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That's standard for us. I'll put the 30-day notice language in the order form, and it'll reference the master agreement you signed in 2023. No change to data terms or support hours.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Can you send that today? Our approvals are Tuesday morning, and I need the PDF before then.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, I'll send the order form this afternoon with 58 seats, June 1 start, June 10 training access, $43,152 annual, net 30, 30-day renewal notice. Who should be listed as signer, still Mark Feldman?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, Mark signs. Copy me and ap@northbridgeequipment.com for the invoice copy. If it matches what we just covered, I can route it today.
